# Upstream source of each file in this directory. oneDNN v3.14.1
# (third_party/ideep/mkl-dnn, cmake/options.cmake) downloads ZenDNN v6.1.2
# at build time, and ZenDNN downloads AOCL-DLP and AOCL-Utils. Recheck these
# files when a oneDNN update changes ZENDNN_RELEASE_TAG.
# THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES comes from the v6.1.2 release branch, which corrects
# the title in the tagged file.
